hazard: Not wearing protective helmet on motorised bicycle

concerns.quote: That it is not compulsory to wear a suitable protective helmet whilst travelling on a motorised bicycle which can reach speeds in excess of 15 MPH
concerns.hazard: not wearing protective helmet on motorised bicycle

concerns.quote: The machine that the deceased was riding was a domestically manufactured machine with a 3.5 litre engine registered in 1973 and as such was exempt from the requirement for the driver/rider to wear either a seatbelt or a protective helmet.
concerns.hazard: domestically manufactured three-wheeled motorised trike with 3.5 litre engine

links.explanation: Both reports highlight that wearing a protective helmet is not legally required for certain types of vehicles. The earlier case concerns motorised bicycles over 15 mph, while the later case concerns older domestically manufactured vehicles exempt from helmet and seat‑belt rules.
links.earlier_quote: That it is not compulsory to wear a suitable protective helmet whilst travelling on a motorised bicycle which can reach speeds in excess of 15 MPH
links.later_quote: (1) The machine that the deceased was riding was a domestically manufactured machine with a 3.5 litre engine registered in 1973 and as such was exempt from the requirement for the driver/rider to wear either a seatbelt or a protective helmet.
